The database is not migrated yet — the type cannot be changed until the migrations have run.

How it works

Club admins cannot change this — only ToAviate staff, and every change is logged

CofA: the Certificate of Airworthiness does not expire — the aircraft is valid while its ARC is. Permit to Fly: the Permit itself expires; with no expiry on file the aircraft reads expired.

Changing the type re-reads the certificate on file as the other kind (its expiry becomes the Permit expiry, or the ARC expiry until the club uploads the ARC) — no date is invented. Ask the club to upload the right document afterwards. "Register" is the UK register copy's category; a mismatch is flagged.
